title: The Bat
description: A mystery writer (Agnes Moorehead) and her friends are stalked by a faceless throat-ripper (Vincent Price) in a haunted house.

title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
description: Emmet Otter and his mother, Ma Otter, are dirt-poor, and they want to get a special present for each other by winning the talent show against the Riverbottom Gang, a group of rich kids with electric instruments.

title: Sabrina the Teen-age Witch
description: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

title: Jeffrey
description: A 30-ish, gay New Yorker (Steven Weber) swears off sex, then falls for an HIV-positive guy (Michael T. Weiss) he meets at the gym.

title: Succubus
description: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

title: The Crush
description: A writer (Cary Elwes) moves into a wealthy family's guest house and befriends a precocious 14-year-old daughter (Alicia Silverstone).

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: Some Girl
description: An insecure young woman (Marissa Ribisi) and her promiscuous best friend (Juliette Lewis) seek relationships.

title: The Blob
description: Formless red slime lands in Pennsylvania and engulfs people; teens (Steven McQueen, Aneta Corseaut) try to warn scoffing adults.

title: Strangers With Candy
description: With her father in a coma, 47-year-old ex-convict Jerri Blank (Amy Sedaris) enrolls in high school and enters a science fair.

title: Q: The Winged Serpent
description: A fleeing gangland flunky (Michael Moriarty) finds the New York nest of Aztec deity Quetzalcoatl, the man-eating flying serpent.

title: Big Fan
description: A football fan (Patton Oswalt) meets his idol in a New York strip club, where his rabid devotion is put to the test and events take a suddenly violent turn.

title: Homicide
description: A Jewish cop faces a crisis of conscience when he learns a shopkeeper may have been killed by an anti-Semitic group.

title: Space Truckers
description: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
description: A young college student tries to impress his girlfriend while trying to meet the expectations of his father; he is asked to man his girlfriend's father's vessel but doesn't know his bow from his elbow.

title: Sea Fever
description: A marine biology student and other crew members fight for survival when an unfathomable life-form attacks their fishing trawler.

title: Piranhaconda
description: After a deranged scientist steals the egg of a hybrid animal, members of a film crew run from the creature before the people become its dinner.

title: Honest Thief
description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

title: Sonny
description: Out of the Army, a man resumes his job as a gigolo in New Orleans and meets a call-girl who works for his mother.

title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
description: Life on Earth is rapidly destroyed except for a small area in Eastern Europe.

title: Sharktopus vs. Pteracuda
description: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a half-pterodactyl, half-barracuda.

title: Battle Creek Brawl
description: In the 1930s, an effete Chicago mobster (Jose Ferrer) pits a Chinese kicker (Jackie Chan) against a king-size brute called Kiss.

title: Dauntless: The Battle of Midway
description: Two men fight for survival after their plane crashes into the Pacific Ocean during the Battle of Midway.

title: Blind Dating
description: After his brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of disastrous dates, a blind man (Chris Pine) falls in love with a nurse (Anjali Jay) from his doctor's office.

title: Silent House
description: Horrifying events turn panic to real terror when a young woman (Elizabeth Olsen) becomes trapped in the old house she's helping her father and uncle renovate.

title: Black Sabbath
description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

title: Quadrophenia
description: A rebellious teen vents his anger with the Mods and the Rockers in 1964 London. Based on the album by the Who.

title: Pete's Meteor
description: Lives change for members of an Irish family after a meteor crashes in their backyard.

title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
description: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
description: Bald, pale, tired and cursed with immortality, Count Dracula (Klaus Kinski) visits a plague of rats upon Europe.

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.

title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest
description: A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.

title: Misbehaviour
description: A team of women hatches a plan to disrupt the 1970 Miss World beauty competition in London.

title: Saturn 3
description: A madman (Harvey Keitel) and his shiny robot chase a May-December couple (Farrah Fawcett, Kirk Douglas) doing food research on Saturn's third moon.

title: The Rebound
description: A newly single woman (Catherine Zeta-Jones) becomes involved with the much-younger man (Justin Bartha) she hired to take care of her children.

title: The Exorcist III
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

title: A Better Tomorrow II
description: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

title: Galaxy of Terror
description: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

title: Wild Side
description: A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).

title: Boyka: Undisputed 4
description: Boyka accidentally kills an opponent in the ring, forcing him to question everything he's worked for. When he finds out his opponent's widow is in trouble, he becomes her champion in a series of seemingly impossible fights.

title: The Eagle Has Landed
description: A Nazi colonel (Robert Duvall) drops a colonel (Michael Caine), a task force and an Irishman (Donald Sutherland) into England to kidnap Winston Churchill.

title: A Boy and His Dog
description: A young man and his talking canine set out in search of food, shelter and females in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

title: The Stunt Man
description: An all-knowing director (Peter O'Toole) toys with a fugitive's (Steve Railsback) mind after making him stuntman on a movie set.

title: Dead Man
description: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.
